verdict.rationale: The official README explicitly lists "AVX, AVX2, AVX512 and AMX support for x86 architectures", which covers every instruction set named in the story. Community reports confirm practical CPU inference on x86 desktops, such as a 4-core i7 running 30B–70B models, though none tie the speed to specific instruction sets. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how each instruction set is enabled or selected (build flags, runtime detection), benchmarks showing speedups from AVX512/AMX, and independent corroboration of the specific instruction-set acceleration.
